saturation.scope: computed versus applied buffer difference; not an independent solver-force measurement

initial_velocity_comparison.scope: original recorded native dynamic state versus held Isaac start; for pose variants original velocities belong to the original pose, not a matched initial dynamic reference

finger_dynamics_audit.note: finger1 active; finger2 passive/mimic; authored USD fields may differ from resolved solver properties

grasp_result.scope: model pose and declared gripper policy throughout; no geometric close gate, refinement or program lift; cube proxy, not LIBERO benchmark
grasp_result.timing_scope: 50ms controls; physics paused during inference; gripper ramp remains 0.1m/s, not native dynamics equivalence

lift_check.scope: 40 successive model-driven controls; kinematic lift/relative-pose evidence, no contact-force measurement

physics_checks.finger_force_scope: computed/applied drive buffers, not object contact forces
